unit_contract.search_volume: Monthly searches reported by a keyword tool. null when unknown.
unit_contract.impressions_90d: This domain's own impressions over a measured 90-day GSC window. Always null in this file: every record here comes from a keyword tool, which cannot observe this site's impressions.
unit_contract.demand_basis: Which field a consumer may score on: search_volume | impressions_90d | none.
unit_contract.removed_field: `volume` is removed. Across this repo that one name held BOTH monthly search volume (keyword-tool rows) and this domain’s own 90-day impressions (GSC rows), so rank_score compared incompatible units. A missing key throws; a wrong number does not.
unit_contract.never: Do not sum or compare across units.
